label: weather-irrops-policy
text: Weather cancellation policy: same-cabin protection is required for gold and platinum travelers when inventory exists. Partner-airline recovery above $650 requires supervisor review. Overnight disruptions may include hotel up to $220 and a $40 meal voucher.

label: partner-airline-rules
text: Approved recovery partners for the transatlantic disruption demo: Partner Atlantic and North Harbor. Partner Atlantic offers same-day lift but any premium-cabin or high-cost recovery must be approved before ticket reissue.

label: airport-operations-lhr
text: LHR disruption support notes: hotel desk remains staffed overnight, wheelchair desk needs manual coordination for reaccommodation, and family hotel blocks are normally available near Terminal 3.

label: traveler-notification-preferences
text: Priority travelers and most corporate passengers in this demo prefer SMS before email. Family and special-assistance cases should receive a concise operational summary after itinerary protection is complete.
